Question: How do I connect to the office Wi-Fi?

Answer (cite every claim as [chunk_id]):

response:
To connect to the office Wi-Fi, you can follow these steps:

* In the office, your laptop will join the CORP Wi-Fi by itself [it-laptop-first-login-howto::s02p0].
* If you're in the office and having trouble connecting, restart your laptop to renew the device certificate [it-wifi-setup-howto::s01p0].
* If you're a visitor or using your personal phone, select the GUEST network and accept the terms on the sign-in page. The guest password is displayed at reception [it-wifi-setup-howto::s02p0].

Note: If you're having trouble connecting to the CORP network, you can raise a ticket in the IT service portal with your office, floor, and the network name you tried [it-wifi-setup-howto::s03p0].
